name: Entities, migrations, and the data layer
summary: Foundation for everything. Entity definition, migration running with rollback, soft delete, timestamps, optimistic locking, and the mechanism by which manifest-declared client entities become real tables. The universal entity events are the backbone of the whole system: search indexing, audit logging, webhooks, automation rules, and reporting all subscribe to them rather than coupling to individual capabilities.

owns.name: Entity
owns.description: The registry of every entity in the resolved graph, including manifest-declared client entities.

owns.name: Migration
owns.description: Applied migration ledger, with checksum and rollback availability.

publishes.name: entity.created
publishes.description: Emitted for every entity in the system. Subscribed to by search indexing, audit, webhooks, automation rules, and reporting.

exposes.description: The only sanctioned data access path. Tenant scoping and append-only enforcement live here, not in convention.

exposes.name: entities
